footnote_text: On November 12, 2026, the Reporting Person was granted 390,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs") of the Issuer pursuant to the Cyabra, Inc. 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. The RSUs vest in eight (8) equal quarterly installments over twenty-four (24) months starting from January 1, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through each applicable vesting date. Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock, par value $0.0001 per share. The RSUs are subject to accelerated vesting upon certain change-in-control events, as provided in the applicable award agreement.
